evals.prompt: Set up issue tracking for a new project. I want to use the file-based backend. The project is called 'myapp', a Python web service. No special labels needed beyond the defaults.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker setup mode offers file-based as recommended, confirms default labels, writes setup-issue-tracker.md with backend=file, path=.kodit/issues, and the five default labels.
expectations: Offers file-based as the recommended backend
Does not create .kodit/issues/ yet (that happens in provision mode)

evals.prompt: Set up issue tracking for a new project. I want to use Linear. We have a team called 'ENG' and I want the project to be called 'taskflow'. I have the Linear MCP connected with write access.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker setup mode offers Linear, confirms team and project name, runs access preflight confirming MCP write access, writes setup-issue-tracker.md with type=linear, team=ENG, linear_project=taskflow, and default labels.
expectations: Offers Linear as the selected backend
Confirms team key and project name
Runs access preflight and confirms MCP write capability
Includes default labels in the draft

evals.prompt: Set up issue tracking for a new project. I want to use Linear, but I don't have any Linear integration set up.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker setup mode detects no MCP or CLI, reports the two remediation paths (connect MCP or install CLI), offers file-based as the alternative, and stops without writing a draft.
expectations: Detects that no Linear integration is available
Does not write a setup draft without confirmed access
Does not create any Linear resources

evals.prompt: I have a Linear setup draft from earlier. Provision the issue tracker resources now. The kodit.json shows type=linear, team=ENG, linear_project=taskflow.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker provision mode creates or finds the Linear project, ensures required workflow states exist, creates labels if missing, and reports what was created or verified.
expectations: Reads the setup draft and kodit.json
Creates or finds the Linear project
Reports what was created or verified

evals.prompt: I have a file-based setup draft. Provision the issue tracker resources now. The kodit.json shows type=file.
evals.expected_output: issue-tracker provision mode creates .kodit/issues/ with README.md and INDEX.md from the file-based conventions. Does not create milestones or stories.
expectations: Does not create milestones or stories
